name: SDSS-LCLUC Standard 9-Class Land Cover Classification
description: Authoritative 9-class land cover definitions, styling, and official crosswalk mapping for SDSS-Platform LCLUC Workspace and GeoServer services.

nodata.name: NoData
nodata.description: Unclassified, cloud/shadow masked, or boundary exclusion pixels. Strictly distinguished from valid class 0 (Water).

classes.definition: 하천, 호소, 저수지, 해양 등 상시 또는 대부분 기간 수면으로 덮여 있는 개방 수면 구역
classes.definition_ko: 하천, 호소, 저수지, 해양 등 상시 또는 대부분 기간 수면으로 덮여 있는 개방 수면 구역
classes.definition_en: Areas where water was predominantly present throughout the year, including rivers, lakes, reservoirs, ponds, coastal and open water bodies.

classes.definition: 교목 수관 피복률이 우세한 산림 및 수목 피복지 (맹그로브 포함, 법적 산림구획과 자동 동일시 불가)
classes.definition_ko: 교목 수관 피복률이 우세한 산림 및 수목 피복지 (맹그로브 포함, 법적 산림구획과 자동 동일시 불가)
classes.definition_en: Areas dominated by trees with canopy cover; includes natural forests, commercial forestry, plantations, and coastal mangroves. Not identical to legal forest zones.

classes.definition: 자연 초원, 목초지, 사바나 초본 식생 및 이끼·지의류 피복지
classes.definition_ko: 자연 초원, 목초지, 사바나 초본 식생 및 이끼·지의류 피복지
classes.definition_en: Open areas covered in natural herbaceous vegetation, grasslands, pasture, rangeland, savanna grasses, and mosses/lichens.

classes.definition: 계절성 또는 영구성 침수 수역에 생육하는 초본·습지 식생 구역
classes.definition_ko: 계절성 또는 영구성 침수 수역에 생육하는 초본·습지 식생 구역
classes.definition_en: Areas of herbaceous wetland, periodically flooded marshes, swamps, tidal mudflat vegetation, and shallow inundation zones.

classes.definition: 일년생 및 다년생 재배 작물, 논, 밭 등 인위적 농업 경작지
classes.definition_ko: 일년생 및 다년생 재배 작물, 논, 밭 등 인위적 농업 경작지
classes.definition_en: Cultivated land with annual or perennial agricultural crops, including rice paddies, irrigated fields, and dry crops.

classes.definition: 낮은 목본 식생, 관목림, 덤불 및 저목 식생 구역
classes.definition_ko: 낮은 목본 식생, 관목림, 덤불 및 저목 식생 구역
classes.definition_en: Areas dominated by woody shrubs, bushes, low scrub, and transitional woody vegetation without a continuous high canopy.

classes.definition: 건물, 도로, 산업시설 등 불투수 인공 구조물이 지표면을 덮고 있는 구역
classes.definition_ko: 건물, 도로, 산업시설 등 불투수 인공 구조물이 지표면을 덮고 있는 구역
classes.definition_en: Human-made structures and impervious surfaces, including residential buildings, paved transport networks, commercial, and industrial facilities.

classes.definition: 식생 피복률이 극히 낮은 암석, 토양, 모래, 자갈, 비포장 공지 및 개간 나지
classes.definition_ko: 식생 피복률이 극히 낮은 암석, 토양, 모래, 자갈, 비포장 공지 및 개간 나지
classes.definition_en: Areas of exposed bare soil, rocks, sand, gravel, quarries, construction clearings, and sparsely vegetated land.

classes.definition: 영구 또는 계절성 적설, 빙하 및 만년설 구역
classes.definition_ko: 영구 또는 계절성 적설, 빙하 및 만년설 구역
classes.definition_en: Areas of permanent or seasonal snow, ice caps, glaciers, and perennial firn.

mappings.notes: Direct correspondence to Trees (1). Satellite spectral canopy cover; not legally synonymous with Kawasan Hutan.
Direct correspondence to Snow & ice (8). Rare in equatorial Indonesia except Puncak Jaya.
CRITICAL: ESA code 80 maps to target Class 0 (Water). Must NOT be confused with ESA source NoData code 0.
Herbaceous wetland maps to Flooded vegetation (3).

CLASSIFICATION LIMITATION: In WorldCover, Mangroves (95) are woody halophytic vegetation mapped to Trees (1) because 9-Class lacks a distinct mangrove class. May exhibit spectral overlap with Flooded vegetation (3).
CLASSIFICATION LIMITATION: Low-profile non-vascular vegetation mapped to Grass (2).

limitations: 1. NoData Disambiguation: Source value 0 represents NoData in WorldCover, but value 0 in the 9-Class standard represents Water. When remapping, source pixel 0 MUST be converted to target NoData 255, and only source pixel 80 converted to target 0 (Water).
2. Mangrove Aggregation: Mangroves (95) are merged into Trees (1). Downstream ecological analysis must account for tidal hydrology and salinity gradients not captured by the generic Trees class.

3. Forest Definition: Tree cover represents 10m spatial resolution satellite canopy detection and does not imply Indonesian Ministry of Environment and Forestry (KLHK) legal forest boundaries or permanent conservation status.

mappings.notes: CLASSIFICATION LIMITATION: Esri combines grass and shrub into single class Rangeland (11). Mapped to Grass (2); separate Shrub (5) cannot be distinguished in Esri data.

limitations: 1. NoData Disambiguation: Source value 0 is NoData in Esri, whereas 1 is Water. In standard 9-class, 0 is Water and 255 is NoData.
2. Rangeland Mixed Class: Esri Land Cover does not separate shrubs from grasses, resulting in zero representation of Shrub & scrub (5) when using Esri as reference.
